text: {"lessons":["My account value fell from 103,030 in Period 2 to 95,140 in Period 10, so I should assess progress over many months rather than react to any one month.","I bought more Stock B after its price rose, then added to all five stocks in Period 6; in future I should use target allocations and a planned contribution schedule instead of making broad or momentum-driven buys.","Holding through the later declines avoided impulsive selling, but my apartment goal is within ten years; I should match investment risk to that timeline and keep money I may need soon in cash."]}
